comment: Approved change classes for the N-vs-R0 comparison (Kagi round 2 restatement 1). A class lands here only after a human-grade review of an actual diff: the class must be a converter normalization, not a content loss. Media LOST/CHANGED classes are never allowlistable. See marathon2/CYCLES.md cycle 2 for the approval notes per class. Approvals from the 2026-11-26 drives: word endnotes/footnotes scaffolding parts and their rels (the editor materializes empty parts R0 does not); xl/sharedStrings.xml (editor materializes shared strings for inline-string originals; every cell value verified equal); xl chart rels + theme (also produced by R0 itself); pptx embedding rename Sheet->Worksheet (same role, with its rels part), notesSlides materialization for slides without notes, theme rels; stylesWithEffects.xml removal (x2t drops the Word-specific part, present in the R0 baseline itself); printerSettings removal (x2t/editor drop, R0-class loss); styles-changed (style IDs remapped, e.g. Heading1->740, but w:name identity verified unchanged).
